Fresenius Appoints Marc-Alexander Mahl to Management Board, Extends CFO Contract
By Andrea Figueras
Fresenius said it named Marc-Alexander Mahl to its management board and extended Sara Hennicken's contract as finance chief.
The German healthcare company said Thursday that Mahl will succeed Pierluigi Antonelli, who is stepping down.

Starting in early November, Mahl will oversee the Fresenius Kabi businesses, bringing more than 20 years of experience in leadership roles at the group. He is currently responsible for the pharma and nutrition segments.
Mahl will continue to lead the pharma unit, while the nutrition business will be managed by Sebastien Guery in the future due to its growing strategic importance, the company said.
Meanwhile, Fresenius extended CFO Sara Hennicken's contract for another five years. Her contract will run until 2032.
The group said that these decisions put the leadership team in place for the company's next phase of growth.
